notes.title: Sex & Coffee ☕️🤎 — FAQ!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, coffee lovers!

Thank you for sharing your impressions! We've received lot of feedback and have already started working on improvements. Here’s a list of frequently asked questions that we’ve got answers for:

❓ [b]What if I can't guess the recipe?[/b]
🔹 The full version of the game will feature convenient hints! We’re also improving the orders and the tutorial. Plus, you won’t need to redo orders—just enjoy quick and stress-free coffee making!

❓ [b]Will the English localization be improved?[/b]
🔹 Localization quality is very important part to us, so we've created a special topic where you can report text issues. Your feedback will definitely be taken into consideration!

❓ [b]Sometimes the game freezes or crashes. What should I do?[/b]
🔹 We’re already working on optimizing this issue! Stay tuned—we’ll post a detailed update.

❓ [b]Will there be an option to view previous dialogue lines?[/b]
🔹 Unfortunately, we can’t add a mouse-wheel rollback feature, as it conflicts with some game mechanics. However, in the full version, you’ll have access to the short dialogue history!

❓ [b]The gameplay feels a bit repetitive. Will there be more content?[/b]
🔹 Don’t worry—this is just a demo! The full version of the game will have many more features, including the ability to spend time with beautiful ladies on dates in six new locations and three steamy threesomes for the true connoisseurs!

❓ [b]Why are the 18+ scenes so short?[/b]
🔹 Yes, they are quite brief in the demo, but that’s only to make sure you’re in for a real treat in the full version.😉

❓ [b]Will there be pregnancy content?[/b] 👀
🔹 We didn't initially plan for this, but found that some players were particularly interested in it. So, here’s a little secret—there will be a girl with a strong breeding kink. Try to guess who?😏

[u][b]That’s all for now! Stay with us—there’s a lot more to come![/b][/u] ❤️

Always yours,
Carnality INC[/h3]

notes.title: 🔥 Thank you for the warm welcome to the Sex & Coffee ☕️🤎 demo!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, everyone!

We see all your comments and suggestions, and we’re working hard to make sure you get nothing but pure enjoyment from the game! And trust us, our capable hands will take care of that for you — literally. 😉

🎯 Important Updates:
✅ Fixed the issue with the missing space before the player’s name; 
✅ English localization quality will be improved.

Since this is a demo, it might not run perfectly on all setups, so we truly appreciate any feedback that helps us optimize the game. If you encounter any technical issues, feel free to share it in the special topic. This is your chance to influence the game directly! ☝️

📢 We’re also preparing a post with answers to the most frequently asked questions — stay tuned![/h3]
